# Madam Monica

> Madam Monica is a Croatian designer womenswear brand and online store offering dresses, blazer coats, blouses, jacquard designs and statement pieces.

Official website: https://www.madam-monica.hr/
Primary language: Croatian (hr-HR)
Additional languages: English and German
Contact: info@madam-monica.hr

## Main collections

- Dresses: https://www.madam-monica.hr/haljine
- Blazer coats and jackets: https://www.madam-monica.hr/sako-jakne
- Blouses: https://www.madam-monica.hr/bluza
- Jacquard dresses: https://www.madam-monica.hr/haljine-od-zakarda
- Full collection: https://www.madam-monica.hr/madam-monica
